selection.scope: each image and each scale independently
selection.score: channel-mean squared residual after stage one
selection.ordering: first-stage error descending; exact ties use ascending raster token index

transport.logical_segment_order: all first-stage scales, all explicit one-bit masks, then all compact active second-stage scales
transport.active_payload_mapping: map A_tx compact values to received-mask active positions in raster order; truncate surplus payload or use stage-two index zero at surplus received active positions
